newsitem.title: CANADA: Bombardier rail unit gets C$26 mln order.
newsitem.headline: Bombardier rail unit gets C$26 mln order.

text.p: Bombardier Inc said on Friday that its German unit Talbot, was awarded a C$26 million contract to supply of railcars to Ostmecklenburg Railway Co, of Germany.

The order is for nine diesel-powered multiple lightweight units, consisting of three cars each. Delivery is scheduled for 1998 and production work is being carried out at the Talbot plant, along with work on an order for 120 three-car units placed in June 1996 by Deutsche Bahn, Bombardier said.

The vehicles are from Talbot's TALENT family of multiple unit, developed to meet the needs of regional and suburban passenger rail operations, Bombardier said. The TALENT is currently in scheduled service in the Netherlands.
